flags: Uses north-to-south driving order to match material’s strip miles, reversing the current Marietta-first narrative. Wingett Run and Dart retain their existing title strings and town coordinates; their bridge subjects lie northeast of those town points.

The Forest Service’s 35 miles describes its interpretive tour, not necessarily the full Woodsfield–Marietta corridor (material maps 46.5 miles). Its approximately four-hour estimate starts at Marietta, so it is not applied to this reversed itinerary.
No byway designation date or campaign is documented; the highway’s 1912 entry into the state system and 1923 renumbering provide road history.
No current claims were dropped for lack of cache support. The Dart naming tradition was omitted because the cached tradition names no identifiable narrator and the bridge story is stronger.
No current vehicle access is inferred for the covered bridges. The cache supports Rinard’s rebuilding in 2006, not survival of the original 1876 structure.
Current motifs are absent; empty arrays supplied.
